# Ignis Web Studio

> Web development studio building fast, conversion-focused websites
> and web applications for small and mid-sized businesses in Europe.
> Specialists in Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and modern web tooling.

## About

- Independent two-person studio
- Founders: Mihail Milenov Kirkov and a business partner
- Services delivered in English and German
- Working with clients across Europe (Germany, Austria, Switzerland,
  Netherlands, and other EN/DE-speaking markets)

## Services

- **Landing Pages** — single-page conversion-focused websites,
  starting at €490
- **Business Websites** — multi-page company websites with CMS and
  SEO, starting at €997
- **Custom Web Applications** — bespoke web apps, dashboards, and
  SaaS-style products, quoted per project

## Tech Stack

- Next.js (React framework)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase, Node.js, Python (when backend is needed)
- GSAP and Three.js (for animations and 3D)
- Vercel (hosting and edge infrastructure)
